from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, List

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single legal judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The exact title of the judgment document as provided in the document")
    nature_description: str | None = Field(description="A short description of the case nature found in the text (e.g., '管辖权异议', '职务侵占罪')")
    case_types: List[Literal['民事案件', '执行案件', '管辖案件', '刑事案件']] = Field(
        description="The list of applicable case categories from the task definition. A document can belong to multiple categories."
    )

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[LegalDocument] = Field(description="Collection of all extracted legal document instances")
